policy: Simulate plausible visual process mechanisms for design judgment. Values are Blender/design estimates, not supplier specifications.

profiles.name: Fine Matte Powder-Coated Metal
profiles.rule: opaque dielectric coat; narrow roughness modulation; weak bump; reject chrome, visible grain and exaggerated orange peel

profiles.name: Injection-Molded PP Fine Matte
profiles.rule: roughness-led microstructure; subtle bump; avoid visible Noise in Base Color

profiles.name: PU Soft Matte Contact Surface
profiles.rule: broader reflection; microstructure subordinate to geometry; avoid rubber caricature

profiles.name: Brushed / Anodized Aluminum Visual Simulation
profiles.rule: tangent direction primary; Wave/Gabor only low-amplitude perturbation; no visible stripes

profiles.name: Milky Transmissive Diffuser Visual Simulation
profiles.rule: preserve Fresnel edge and thickness; visually tune scatter; avoid clear glass and flat emission-card reading
